overview.lead: The Skyborne, the Alliance High Order, are a new race in Forever and need a paid Forever pack. Their racial Wind-Blessed gives +2% haste, and their Attuned bonus is removed when you enter a raid.

points.text: Skyborne can be a Druid, Hunter, Mage, Rogue or Warrior.
No racial grants weapon skill in Forever, so a Skyborne's weapon choice is free of racial math.

heldBack.text: Skyborne needs a paid Forever upgrade and has its own bird-like form models. On 26 Oct its Read Ley Line racial dropped to a 50% regen bonus that can't be used during Innervate.
heldBack.reason: Druid overview prose with no grade or source; no reviewed fact holds the form models or the Read Ley Line value.

heldBack.text: Skyborne is new to the class and needs a paid Forever upgrade, such as a Skyborne pack; a plain subscription does not include the race.
heldBack.reason: The pack requirement is carried as race-skyborne.pack; the plain-subscription line has no grade or source.

steps.text: Check your account first: the Skyborne race needs a paid Forever pack.
Pick one of the five Skyborne classes: Druid, Hunter, Mage, Rogue or Warrior.
Skyborne is a new race. The other new Alliance options are new classes for existing races: Human Hunter, Dwarf Shaman and Gnome Priest.

steps.text: As a Skyborne Hunter, do your race's own versions of the Taming the Beast quests on Zephras Isle at level 10.
Finish with Training the Beast, which unlocks Beast Training, Feed Pet and Revive Pet.

As a Skyborne Druid, expect your form quests to start on Zephras Isle, but treat the details as unconfirmed. A single report (Method) names 'The Great Ursera Spirit' for Bear and 'The Great Windborne Cat Spirit' for Cat, and other reports disagree.
As a Skyborne Warrior, expect a race-specific quest at level 10 that unlocks Defensive Stance. Taunt and Sunder Armor are trained after it.

mistakes.mistake: Treating the Skyborne Druid quest names as settled.
mistakes.fix: Only one report (Method) gives them, and other reports disagree on the NPCs and start points.

mistakes.mistake: Following the Bartleby quest as a Skyborne Warrior.
mistakes.fix: The Defensive Stance quest is race-specific, and the Bartleby quest is the Human version.

201.summary: How Wind-Blessed compares with the other Alliance racials for raiding Hunters and Mages.

chapters.title: Wind-Blessed next to the other raid racials

steps.text: For a raiding Hunter, the 26 October racials are Dwarf Artisan's Precision +1% hit, Human Ruthless +1% crit and Skyborne Wind-Blessed +2% haste.
For a raiding Mage, weigh Wind-Blessed's +2% haste against Human Ruthless +1% crit and Gnome Eureka!, an 8 sec buff that makes non-periodic abilities 10% cheaper and stronger.
Leave Attuned out of the comparison: it is removed when you enter a raid.

mistakes.mistake: Counting Attuned when comparing raid racials.
mistakes.fix: Attuned is removed when you enter a raid. Compare Wind-Blessed's +2% haste instead.
